protocol_definitions.strat_cv: (i) same-type latent, 5-fold GroupKFold over episodes stratified by size group
protocol_definitions.gt_transfer: (ii) train on GT encodings only (held-out episodes), apply to predicted latents
protocol_definitions.upper: (iii) train on GT + tf1 + ol latents of all sizes (held-out episodes), test on predicted latents
protocol_definitions.heldout_size: (iv) train on GT encodings of the sizes the world model was trained on (held-out episodes), test on gt/tf1/ol of all sizes, summarised per role

metrics.acc_cls: exact size-class accuracy (classes = ordered sizes of the dataset; null when the class is absent from training)
metrics.r2_within_group: R2 after removing per-group means of y and y_hat
metrics.slope: slope of predicted vs real log-area over all samples
metrics.ci: episode-level cluster bootstrap (resampling within group), 2.5/97.5 percentiles, averaged over probe seeds

label_note: h0..h6 use the area of the input frame; gt/tf1/ol/rvit/pix use the area of the frame the latent represents
